An instrument that ties each changed row to its customer, so that the case rows and the status updates can be matched to the approved list one by one. An instrument that reads the live tables directly after the promotion, instead of relying on the promotion's line in the record. Taking same set and summary of the change again at A2 or A3 would add nothing, because they read the kept staged set and say what they said at A1. A second undo rehearsal at A2 was not worth its price of 66: the sending cannot be undone, and an undo of the promotion would not change that.
